name: Test Workflow
on: push: branches: - develop workflow_dispatch:
jobs: test: name: Test Job runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Print hello run: echo "Hello from GitHub Actions!"
- name: Print environment run: | echo "GitHub ref: ${{ github.ref }}" echo "GitHub event: ${{ github.event_name }}"
- name: Test secrets exist run: | echo "Testing if secrets are accessible..." if [ -n "$TEST_SECRET" ]; then echo "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID exists (length: ${#TEST_SECRET})" else echo "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is NOT set" fi env: TEST_SECRET: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
- name: Success run: echo "All tests passed!"
